title: एकोनविंशत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Bhishma tells an old dialogue between Indra and the asura Namuci, who has lost his place and sits in a quiet, unafraid mind. Namuci says that one Ordainer rules all, that he is driven as water runs downhill, and that the man who is not moved by gain or loss is a true bearer of burdens.
summary.kn: ಇಂದ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಾನ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡ ಅಸುರ ನಮುಚಿಯ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಸಂವಾದವನ್ನು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ಶಾಸಕ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಆಳುತ್ತಾನೆ, ನೀರು ಇಳಿಜಾರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಿಯುವಂತೆ ತಾನು ನಡೆಸಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತೇನೆ, ಲಾಭ-ನಷ್ಟಗಳಿಂದ ವಿಚಲಿತನಾಗದವನೇ ನಿಜ ಭಾರಧಾರಿ ಎಂದು ನಮುಚಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीष्म इन्द्र और स्थान खो चुके असुर नमुचि का प्राचीन संवाद सुनाते हैं। नमुचि कहता है कि एक ही विधाता सबका शासक है, वह ढलान पर बहते जल की तरह चलाया जा रहा है, और लाभ-हानि से अविचल पुरुष ही सच्चा भारवाही है।
summary.te: ఇంద్రునికి, స్థానం కోల్పోయిన అసురుడు నముచికి మధ్య పురాతన సంవాదాన్ని భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు. ఒకే విధాత అందరినీ పాలిస్తాడని, నీరు వాలులో ప్రవహించినట్లు తాను నడపబడతానని, లాభ నష్టాలకు చలించనివాడే నిజమైన భారవాహకుడని నముచి అంటాడు.
summary.ta: இந்திரனுக்கும் இடம் இழந்த அசுரன் நமுசிக்கும் இடையிலான பழைய உரையாடலைப் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார். ஒரே விதாதா எல்லோரையும் ஆள்கிறான், நீர் சரிவில் ஓடுவது போல் தான் செலுத்தப்படுகிறேன், ஆதாயம் இழப்பில் அசையாதவனே உண்மையான சுமை தாங்கி என்கிறான் நமுசி.
summary.ml: സ്ഥാനം നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ട്, ശാന്തവും നിർഭയവുമായ മനസ്സോടെ ഇരിക്കുന്ന അസുരൻ നമുചിയും ഇന്ദ്രനും തമ്മിലുള്ള പഴയ സംഭാഷണം ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു. ഒരു നിയന്താവ് എല്ലാം ഭരിക്കുന്നുവെന്നും, വെള്ളം താഴേക്ക് ഒഴുകുന്നതുപോലെ താൻ നയിക്കപ്പെടുന്നുവെന്നും നമുചി പറയുന്നു; ലാഭനഷ്ടങ്ങളാൽ ഇളകാത്തവനാണ് യഥാർത്ഥ ഭാരം വഹിക്കുന്നവനെന്നും.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.219; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
शतक्रतोश्च संवादं नमुचेश्च युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: On this they tell this ancient account, Yudhishthira, the conversation of Indra and Namuci.

verses.text:
श्रिया विहीनमासीनमक्षोभ्यमिव सागरम् ।
भवाभवज्ञं भूतानामित्युवाच पुरंदरः ॥

meaning.en: To Namuci, who sat stripped of fortune, unshaken as the sea, and who knew the rise and fall of beings, Indra said:

verses.text:
बद्धः पाशैश्च्युतः स्थानाद्द्विषतां वशमागतः ।
श्रिया विहीनो नमुचे शोचस्याहो न शोचसि ॥

meaning.en: 'Bound in fetters, fallen from your place, come under the power of your foes, deprived of fortune, Namuci, do you grieve, or not?'

verses.text: नमुचिरुवाच

meaning.en: Namuci said:

verses.text:
अनवाप्यं च शोकेन शरीरं चोपतप्यते ।
अमित्राश्च प्रहृष्यन्ति नास्ति शोके सहायता ॥

meaning.en: Grief gains nothing and torments the body; enemies rejoice, and there is no help in grief.

verses.text:
तस्माच्छक्र न शोचामि सर्वं ह्येवेदमन्तवत् ।
संतापाद्भ्रश्यते रूपं धर्मश्चैव सुरेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: So, Indra, I do not grieve, for all this has an end. Through torment one's beauty and one's dharma are lost, lord of the gods.

verses.text:
विनीय खलु तद्दुःखमागतं वैमनस्यजम् ।
ध्यातव्यं मनसा हृद्यं कल्याणं संविजानता ॥

meaning.en: Having driven off the sorrow that came from dejection, one who understands should meditate in mind on what is pleasant and good.

verses.text:
यथा यथा हि पुरुषः कल्याणे कुरुते मनः ।
तदैवास्य प्रसीदन्ति सर्वार्था नात्र संशयः ॥

meaning.en: For as a man sets his mind on the good, so all his aims become clear; of this there is no doubt.

verses.text:
एकः शास्ता न द्वितीयोऽस्ति शास्ता
गर्भे शयानं पुरुषं शास्ति शास्ता ।
तेनानुशिष्टः प्रवणादिवोदकं
यथा नियुक्तोऽस्मि तथा वहामि ॥

meaning.en: There is one ruler, and no second ruler; the ruler governs a man lying in the womb. Taught by him, as water flows down a slope, I go as I am directed.

verses.text:
भावाभावावभिजानन्गरीयो
जानामि श्रेयो न तु तत्करोमि ।
आशाः सुशर्म्याः सुहृदां सुकुर्व-
न्यथा नियुक्तोऽस्मि तथा वहामि ॥

meaning.en: Understanding being and non-being, I know the better, yet I do not do it. Making hopes of friends easy to bear, I go as I am directed.

verses.text:
यथा यथास्य प्राप्तव्यं प्राप्नोत्येव तथा तथा ।
भवितव्यं यथा यच्च भवत्येव तथा तथा ॥

meaning.en: In whatever way a man is to obtain what he must obtain, he obtains it just so; and what must be, comes about just so.

verses.text:
यत्र यत्रैव संयुङ्क्ते धाता गर्भं पुनः पुनः ।
तत्र तत्रैव वसति न यत्र स्वयमिच्छति ॥

meaning.en: Wherever the creator places the embryo, again and again, there it dwells, not where it itself wishes.

verses.text:
भावो योऽयमनुप्राप्तो भवितव्यमिदं मम ।
इति यस्य सदा भावो न स मुह्येत्कदाचन ॥

meaning.en: One who always holds that 'this state that has come to me had to be' will never be deluded.

verses.text:
पर्यायैर्हन्यमानानामभियोक्ता न विद्यते ।
दुःखमेतत्तु यद्द्वेष्टा कर्ताहमिति मन्यते ॥

meaning.en: For those struck by the turns of fortune there is no one to accuse; but it is sorrow when the hater thinks, 'I am the doer.'

verses.text:
ऋषींश्च देवांश्च महासुरांश्च
त्रैविद्यवृद्धांश्च वने मुनींश्च ।
कान्नापदो नोपनमन्ति लोके
परावरज्ञास्तु न संभ्रमन्ति ॥

meaning.en: Sages, gods, great asuras, elders learned in the three Vedas, and hermits in the forest: whom do misfortunes not reach in the world? But those who know the high and low are not confused.

verses.text:
न पण्डितः क्रुध्यति नापि सज्जते
न चापि संसीदति न प्रहृष्यति ।
न चार्थकृच्छ्रव्यसनेषु शोचति
स्थितः प्रकृत्या हिमवानिवाचलः ॥

meaning.en: The wise man is not angry, nor attached; he neither sinks nor rejoices, nor grieves in loss of wealth or calamity; he stands by nature like the Himalaya, unmoved.

verses.text:
यमर्थसिद्धिः परमा न हर्षये-
त्तथैव काले व्यसनं न मोहयेत् ।
सुखं च दुःखं च तथैव मध्यमं
निषेवते यः स धुरंधरो नरः ॥

meaning.en: One whom the highest success does not thrill, and whom calamity in due time does not bewilder, who takes pleasure and pain alike with equanimity, is a man who can bear the load.

verses.text:
यां यामवस्थां पुरुषोऽधिगच्छे-
त्तस्यां रमेतापरितप्यमानः ।
एवं प्रवृद्धं प्रणुदेन्मनोजं
संतापमायासकरं शरीरात् ॥

meaning.en: Whatever state a man comes to, he should delight in it without distress; so he should drive from his body the grown, mind-born torment that brings toil.

verses.text:
तत्सदः स परिषत्सभासदः
प्राप्य यो न कुरुते सभाभयम् ।
धर्मतत्त्वमवगाह्य बुद्धिमा-
न्योऽभ्युपैति स पुमान्धुरंधरः ॥

meaning.en: The man who, having reached an assembly, its members and its seats, feels no fear of the assembly, and who has plunged into the essence of dharma, that wise man is a bearer of the load.

verses.text:
प्राज्ञस्य कर्माणि दुरन्वयानि
न वै प्राज्ञो मुह्यति मोहकाले ।
स्थानाच्च्युतश्चेन्न मुमोह गौतम-
स्तावत्कृच्छ्रामापदं प्राप्य वृद्धः ॥

meaning.en: The works of the wise are hard to trace; the wise are not confused in times of confusion. Even when he was fallen from his place, Gautama was not confused, though in old age he met such severe calamity.

verses.text:
न मन्त्रबलवीर्येण प्रज्ञया पौरुषेण वा ।
अलभ्यं लभते मर्त्यस्तत्र का परिदेवना ॥

meaning.en: By mantra, strength, valour, wisdom or manliness, a mortal does not gain what is not his to gain; what is there to lament?

verses.text:
यदेवमनुजातस्य धातारो विदधुः पुरा ।
तदेवानुभविष्यामि किं मे मृत्युः करिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Whatever the ordainers laid down long ago for one born so, that I shall experience; what can death do to me?

verses.text:
लब्धव्यान्येव लभते गन्तव्यान्येव गच्छति ।
प्राप्तव्यान्येव प्राप्नोति दुःखानि च सुखानि च ॥

meaning.en: A man gets only what is to be got, goes only where he is to go, and receives only the sorrows and joys that are to be received.

verses.text:
एतद्विदित्वा कार्त्स्न्येन यो न मुह्यति मानवः ।
कुशलः सुखदुःखेषु स वै सर्वधनेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: The man who, knowing all this fully, is not bewildered, and is skilled in pleasure and pain, is truly lord of all wealth.
